detail.longDescription: # ChatGPT is also quite useless with # Nix related things in many cases apparently. I asked how to extract config values like "services.jellyfin.enable" out of a closure and it at most provides "nixos-option" which doesn't work when the git repository you've built that system from isn't available. Like e.g. when you're inside a VM built with build-vm or simply have moved/deleted it since then. Everything else was it trying to gaslight me that arguments exist that don't. # Nix # NixOS
